backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining user profiles, work items, tasks, content plans, channels, and notes with per‑user storage and authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping PWA, service worker, install UX, and notifications features to source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of many frontend React files including pages, components, hooks, and PWA/notification utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base theme with OKLCH color variables and light/dark mode support.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry file including PWA manifest, icons, metadata, and root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: Web app manifest defining PWA metadata, icons, theme colors, and RTL Persian settings.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page with simple styling and retry button.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing caching, offline fallback, and cache version management.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React app root configuring router, theme provider, app shell, and page routes.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Root layout with navigation, header, PWA install logic, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Wraps children with authentication checks and shows login or profile setup when needed.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays the login UI and triggers Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/notes/NoteFormDi: Form dialog for creating or editing notes with title and content fields.
frontend/src/components/planner/ContentP: Form dialog for adding or editing content plans with channel, type, and status selection.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Dialog for collecting and saving the user's display name on first login.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallBanne: Banner prompting the user to install the PWA or showing installed status.
frontend/src/components/reminders/Remind: Background listener that feeds tasks and work items into the reminders system.
frontend/src/components/settings/Channel: Form dialog for creating or editing social channel profiles with metadata fields.
Displays a list of channel profiles with add, edit, and delete actions using dialogs and confirmations.
frontend/src/components/settings/ImportE: Provides JSON export and import of user data with file handling and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification permissions and allows sending a test notification.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskFormDi: Form dialog for creating or editing tasks with title and priority fields.
frontend/src/components/work-inbox/WorkI: Form dialog for creating or editing work inbox items, including description, source, and status.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, work inbox items, tasks, content plans, notes, and channels via an actor API.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for light/dark themes plus global and RTL styles.
frontend/src/lib/fa.ts: Contains a large Farsi translation dictionary for UI labels, actions, statuses, and section titles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/src/notifications/useNotificati: Implements a hook to manage notification permissions and send notifications, including a test notification.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Renders the dashboard overview showing counts of inbox items, tasks, content plans, and notes using various query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/NotesPage.tsx: Displays a searchable list of notes with create, edit, delete, and copy actions using Notes-related query hooks.
Multi‑step onboarding UI allowing users to create an initial channel and optional sample task/note before navigating to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/PlannerPage.tsx: Displays and manages content plans with filtering, editing, deletion, and creation via dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings hub providing notification settings, channel management, import/export tools, and a link back to onboarding.
frontend/src/pages/TasksTodayPage.tsx: Shows today's tasks with creation, editing, completion toggling, and deletion options.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInboxPage.tsx: Manages work inbox items with search, filtering, creation, editing, and deletion using a table layout.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers the service worker, checks for updates, and prompts users to reload when a new version is available.
frontend/src/pwa/usePwaInstallPrompt.ts: React hook handling PWA installation prompts, tracking installability, installation state, and user dismissal.
frontend/src/reminders/useReminders.ts: React hook that checks overdue tasks and new work items, sends notifications or toasts, and persists reminder state.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading URL params, storing them in sessionStorage, and managing persisted parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state and metadata describing features, requirements, and app-level configuration.
